title: Printing to Console
description:
To print to console in C, there is one prerequisit:
You must put `#include <stdio.h>` at the top of your file (I'll explain later).
Then, you can print to console using the `printf` function. You just run `printf("<Text you want to print>");`
The `stdio.h` part is because `printf` isn't a part of C. It's in the _standard library_, and the `#include` says "Hey C, this exists". (`stdio` == `Standard I/O`)
